widgets.title: Total Faxes
nrql: SELECT sum(acme_backend.outreach.fax) FROM Metric WHERE clusterName = 'acme-cluster-prod'

notes: assumed gauge 'acme_backend_outreach_fax'; verify metric name/type in Mimir and add to metric_map if wrong
sum() of a gauge: NR sums datapoints; emitted sum of per-series averages (current-total semantics)

widgets.title: Fax status

notes: FACET attribute 'status' not in label_map; used 'status'

FACET without LIMIT: NR returns the top 10 groups by default, the translated query returns ALL groups — wrap in topk(10, ...) if the cardinality is high
